headline: 电影新剧齐热：《挑情丑闻》首播
summary: 电影热作《希望》《魔法情缘》等持续领跑；新剧《挑情丑闻》今日首播，热播剧《菜鸟老警》《龙族》《瑞克和莫蒂》等保持高热度，待映《猫鼬》《挖掘者》受期待。

industryHighlights.text: 电影热作：《希望》《魔法情缘》《起义》《死亡禁区实录》《我想留在你身边》本周在榜。
industryHighlights.en: Movie hits this week include Hope, Magic Romance, Uprising, Death Zone Record, and I Want to Stay by Your Side.

industryHighlights.text: 新剧首播：《挑情丑闻》本周上线，关注度上升。
industryHighlights.en: New series Tiaqing Scandal premieres this week, drawing rising attention.

industryHighlights.text: 热播剧：《菜鸟老警》《瑞克和莫蒂》《权力的游戏前传：龙族》《梦魇绝镇》《黑色丽人》持续热播。
industryHighlights.en: Hot series include The Rookie, Rick and Morty, House of the Dragon, From, and Black Beauty.

industryHighlights.text: 待映电影：《猫鼬》《假如爱有如果》《爱情假说》《挖掘者》《野兽之心》待映。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming films include Mongoose, If Love Had If, The Love Hypothesis, The Digger, and Heart of the Beast.

headlineEn: Movie & TV Buzz: New Series Premieres
summaryEn: Movie hits like Hope and Magic Romance lead; new series Tiaqing Scandal premieres today, while The Rookie, House of the Dragon, and Rick and Morty stay hot; upcoming films Mongoose and The Digger draw anticipation.
